subject: R code to run the INLA algorithm

messages.author: a0c723893f46c42b
messages.subject: R code to run the INLA algorithm
parts:
I plan to include INLA in my teaching. To explain the Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation algorithm it would be great to have code in R for the algorithm, including the numerical integration and Laplace approximations. Does anyone have R code to run the INLA algorithm solving a Poisson GLMM for instance?

Best regards,
Lars

PS Just to clarify, I do not want to run an example in the R-INLA package.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] R code to run the INLA algorithm
parts:
On Thu, 2019-06-06 at 07:54 -0700, Lars Rönnegård wrote:
> I plan to include INLA in my teaching. To explain the Integrated
> Nested Laplace Approximation algorithm it would be great to have code
> in R for the algorithm, including the numerical integration and
> Laplace approximations. Does anyone have R code to run the INLA
> algorithm solving a Poisson GLMM for instance?

I do not have any complete example (without using inla()), but I have some
simpler R-examples, like the attached one, which illustrate the use of
the laplace approximation for a logististic regression case. the dimension is 2
but its the same thing happening in higher dimension. In my other examples, I'm using
inla() to do the calculations without doing it in R...

I have slides for the hole GMRF book if that would be of any help, let me know

H



--
Håvard Rue
Helpdesk
he...@r-inla.org

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] R code to run the INLA algorithm
parts:
I have one in Portuguese for the Tokyo example (Binomial) which could be
easy to adapt for Poisson. However, it only does the first Laplace
approximation, not the second one. See it in the following link
http://www.leg.ufpr.br/~elias/ensino/ce092/tutorials/gmrf-approximation-tokyo.html

Elias
